title: Private Moraine Lake, Lake Louise & Emerald Lake - Banff/Canmore
blurb:
THE EXPERIENCE:
A private, tailored escape to the three most breathtaking lakes in the Canadian Rockies: Louise, Moraine & Emerald. We combine a feast for the eyes with active immersion, moving past the crowds to enjoy the changing colours and mountain vistas along the shoreline trails of each basin. Enjoy direct, hassle-free access to Moraine Lake from the exclusive comfort of our van and skip the public shuttle queues.

- Private tour (max. 11 guests)
- Duration: ~9 hrs
- Door-to-door transport from anywhere in Banff or Canmore, with park passes included
- Picnic lunch & refreshments provided
- Difficulty: Easy to Moderate.

ABOUT MOLARI:
As a family-run boutique, we prioritize a safe, ethical, and immersive approach to sharing the beauty of Western Canada:

- Private, tailored experiences only
- Founder-led journeys – your guide isn't "just here for the season"
- Our van: high-roof design, all-wheel drive, and remote start AC/heat
- Fully licensed, insured, and permitted.
